ja289:1.1: Nānacchandā mahārāja ekāgāre vasāmase, ahaṃ gāmavaraṃ icche, brāhmaṇī ca gavaṃ sataṃ,
ja289:2.1: Chatto ca ājaññarathaṃ, kaññā ca maṇikuṇḍalaṃ, yā c' esā Puṇṇikā jammī udukkhalaṃ abhikaṃkhatīti.
ja289:3.1: Brāhmaṇassa gāmavaraṃ detha brāhmaṇiyā gavaṃ sataṃ Chattassa ājaññarathaṃ kaññāya maṇikuṇḍalaṃ, yañ c' etaṃ Puṇṇikaṃ jammiṃ paṭipādetha udukkhalan ti
